about: What a release decides about the machine it lands on. Memory: need = memory in use after the new version is ready on a copy of the app's data + the opener's peak; memory = need x headroom_factor, rounded up to step_megabytes, never below the provider floor per CPU for the machine's CPU kind. A release sizes in both directions from this and never copies the size of the machine it replaces. environment_no_longer_read: settings the runtime has stopped reading, which a release does not carry forward.
